paragraphs.text: The following are named artifacts, legendary artifacts, or those that have significant roles within the storyline .
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Avishkar .

Aetherwing is a legendary vehicle and the Golden-Scale Flagship seen on Avishkar during its invasion by the Phyrexians . It was built by Saheeli , who was inspired by Ixalani pterodons having a sleek shape similar to the winged dinosaurs. It is an airship powered by aether . It gains power equal to the number of artifacts the player controls. It is associated with red and blue mana.
Aetherwing, Golden-Scale Flagship

Skysovereign is a legendary vehicle and the Kaladeshi Consulate's Flagship on Avishkar. It is a large golden skyship featuring several buildings on top of it. Whenever it enters or attacks, it deals damage to creatures or planeswalkers under the opponent's control. It was used as a skinned card for Da Vulcha from the Warhammer 40,000: Orks Secret Lair .
Skysovereign, Consul Flagship
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Dominaria .

Akroma's Memorial is a large memorial statue dedicated to Akroma that was created by 4500 and existed during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . It is a white stone statue of her with her wings spread and holding her sword up to the sky. The memorial is inscribed with the text "Those who do evil shall face wrath unrelenting." and "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."

The Helm of the Host is a legendary equipment from Dominaria that serves as the crown of the queen of Vesuva . It was worn by Omo in the Multiverse and by Solaflora in the Un-iverse . It is an open-faced metal helm with four additional faces on its front, two along each side of the wearer's face. It creates token copies of the equipped creature.
Solaflora, Intergalactic Icon

A magical Reflecting Mirror that Jodah received from Voska , it was a versatile accessory that aided Jodah many times in his lifetime, such as curing Ith, storing Jodah's extended memories, defending him in combat, supporting the Worldspell, and as its final action igniting Jaya Ballard 's spark.

The Mox Amber is a legendary mox from Dominaria comprised of amber held as a pendant on a necklace. It is said to be a moment in time made tangible that has the power to realize epic visions. It adds one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers the player controls.
The Reaver Cleaver was a weapon used during the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . It is an axe capable of turning blood or body parts into valuable materials through unknown means.

The Thran Temporal Gateway is a legendary artifact seen on the plane of Dominaria . It is a Thran portal from the past. It is comprised of a metal circle with a green energy portal inside it. It allows casting of historic permanents from the player's hand to the battlefield for 4 colorless mana.
Thran Temporal Gateway

The Thrumming Stone is a legendary artifact seen on the plane of Dominaria . It is a tall obelisk of stone that was found in the snowy mountains of Terisiare during the end of the Ice Age . It appears to cause ripples of spells cast near it.

The Timeless Lotus is a legendary artifact and lotus seen on the plane of Dominaria near the time of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . It is a lotus growing out of a relic of one of Urza 's past war machines. It was said that after he used nature to power his vast war machines, nature returned by exploiting their remains to renew itself. It appears as a glowing white lotus growing out of the metal hand of a destroyed machine. It can add mana of all five colors.

The Wand of Ith was an artifact created by Lord Ith during his tenure as leader of the Conclave of Mages in the Dark Age , with little else known about it. When Mairsil usurped his teacher's position, he stole the wand and used it for himself. Mairsil regularly carried the wand with him and used it to weaken any resistance against him. When Mairsil faced down Primata Delphine of the Church of Tal during her assault on the Conclave, Mairsil used the wand on her with good effect, draining away her magical defenses and then stabbing her to death.
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Eldraine .

The Throne of Eldraine is a legendary artifact from Eldraine and as its name suggests, the throne of the High King of the plane. It appears as a red chair accented by gold set upon a dais with the banners of each of the five realms of Eldraine behind it.
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Innistrad .

The Slayer's Bounty is a legendary artifact clue from Innistrad . It is a wanted poster depicting a werewolf to be hunted. It is a spellbook that gives access to various spells to assist with capturing a target.
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Ixalan .

The Enigma Jewel is a legendary artifact seen on the plane of Ixalan . It is a metallic cross-section of a face that glows red. Connected above the face is a circle with a red jewel at its center. It transforms into the Locus of Enlightenment . It creates 2 colorless mana that can only be spent on activated abilities. It is associated with blue mana.

The Everflowing Well is a legendary artifact seen on the plane of Ixalan . It is a well comprised of stone with a facet comprised of a snake head where the water flows from its mouth. The well flows into the Myriad Pools .

Indomitable is a legendary vehicle seen on the plane of Ixalan . It is a named pirate ship . It can be cast from the graveyard if the player has three or more tapped pirates or vehicles. It is associated with blue mana.

The Locus of Enlightenment is a legendary artifact from Ixalan that is created from the Enigma Jewel . It is a metallic cross-section of a face that draws in glowing red energy into it. It has all of the activated abilities of those non-lands used to craft it and copies any activated ability to be triggered again. It is associated with blue mana.
Locus of Enlightenment

The Millennium Calendar is a legendary artifact from Ixalan . It is a giant metal calendar that keeps track of time on the plane. It builds up time counters and has the ability to double them. It can be sacrificed after 1000 of the counters are on it to cause each opponent to lose 1000 life.
The Millennium Calendar

The Skullspore Nexus is a legendary artifact from Ixlan that appears to be a stone dais on the ground with a dinosaur skull in its center that has a large amount of mushrooms and glowing fungi growing out from it. It creates Fungus Dinosaurs whenever other creatures die near it, with their power & toughness being equal to the total power & toughness of the dead creatures. It also has an activated ability to double a target creature's power. It is associated with green mana.

The Thaumatic Compass is a legendary artifact from Ixlan . It is a silver compass that points toward planeswalking magic. It is made up of a series of stacks of circles and etchings, with one long point extending from an empty ring on its side. Nicol Bolas gave the compass to Vraska on the Meditation Plane to assist her in finding the Immortal Sun in the city of Orazca on Ixalan . After finding the city, Vraska kept the compass in her apartment on Ravnica .
Vraska, Golgari Queen ( Mythic Edition )
The Thousand Moons Smithy is a legendary artifact from Ixlan . It is a magical smithy located in Ixalan's Core that is operated by the Gnomes to create more Gnome Soldiers .
Thousand Moons Smithy
Barracks of the Thousand
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Kamigawa .

The Eater of Virtue is a legendary piece of equipment from Kamigawa from the modern Neon Dynasty era. It is a blade that eats the soul of those who die wielding it. If a creature dies while equipped, it is exiled, and the sword will grant the next equipped creature its evergreen keyword abilities .
Artifacts originating from or first seen on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

The Chronicle of Victory is a legendary artifact and tapestry from Lorwyn that depicts the Phyrexian Invasion of the Multiverse and the plane's united victory over its foe. It depicts elves , boggarts , faeries , and flamekin of the plane fighting against the Phyrexians showcasing Realmbreaker coming through an Omenpath in the sky like a large serpent.
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the Meditation Plane .
The Gem of Becoming is a legendary artifact and gem on the Meditation Plane, similar to and possibly connected to the Spirit-Gem .
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of New Phyrexia or the former plane of Mirrodin .

The Mindslaver is a legendary artifact from Mirrodin , that is a metal helmet that mind controls the wearer. It covers the top of their head and eyes with wires going into their neck. It was the first card to allow controlling another player .
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Ravnica .
The God-Pharaoh's Statue is a legendary artifact from Ravnica during the War of the Spark . It was a statue of Nicol Bolas that was later toppled by Vitu-Ghazi during the war.
Giant Growth ( War of the Spark )
Plains ( War of the Spark , #250 )
Planewide Celebration
Sorin's Thirst ( War of the Spark )
Topple the Statue ( War of the Spark )
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Tarkir .

The Dragon Throne of Tarkir is a legendary artifact and equipment from Tarkir's original timeline. It acts as the throne of the leader of the Mardu Horde and was formed from Kolaghan 's skull. It gives the equipped creature Defender and has an activated ability to give other creatures trample and a power & toughness increase based on the equipped creature's power.
Dragon Throne of Tarkir
The Stormforged Armor is a legendary artifact and equipment from Tarkir. It is a set of Mardu armor that has various conductive orbs of electricity that allow it to flow over the armor.
Artifacts originating from or first seen on the plane of Theros
The Hall of Triumph is a legendary artifact from Theros . It is a hall that features a statue of Elspeth Tirel . It gives +1/+1 to creatures of a chosen color.

The Nyx Lotus is a legendary artifact from Theros . It is a lotus located in Nyx that appears as a large pink & purple flower with energy waves coming off of it. It allows the player to choose a color and then adds mana equak to the player's devotion to that color.
Artifacts originating from the Edge .

The Dominion Bracelet is a legendary artifact from the Edge. It is Sunstar Free Company equipment that appears as a white metallic bracelet with a red crystal on it that emits energy. It is an allusion to the eponymous Lens from the Lensman series by American author E. E. "Doc" Smith .
The Dominion Bracelet

The Eternity Elevator is a massive legendary artifact from the Edge that rises from a planet into space. It is a Pinnacle Eternity column based on the real-world concept of space elevators , thousands-of-kilometers-long structures used for launching ships into space.
The Eternity Elevator
Artifacts originating from an unknown plane in the Multiverse .

The Chromatic Orrery is a legendary artifact from an unknown location in the multiverse. It is a model of New Phyrexia with spheres representing the plane and its moons. It was located in a public location where visitors would marvel at its design, but were unaware of the other world that inspired it.

The Terminus of Return is a legendary Terminus Stone located on an unknown plane. It appears as a large black rock jutting out of the ground with a pattern carved into it that glows with purple light. It is indestructable , associated with black mana , and can be activated by exiling a creature. Once activated, it brings creatures back to life. It is presumed to be one of six such legendary stones.
The Terminus of Return

The Tome of the Infinite is a legendary artifact and book from an unknown location in the multiverse. It is a book that contains numerous powerful spells within it including Swords of Plowshares , Light of Hope , Ponder , Force Spike , Dark Ritual , Duress , Lightning Bolt , Assault Strobe , Giant Growth , and Fog . It is associated with blue mana.
Artifacts originating from the Un-iverse .

The Kindslaver is a legendary artifact from Bablovia in the Un-iverse . It is a mechanical helmet that goes over a humanoid head with two containers of liquid on each side that feed into the mouth through a tube. It is a reference to the Mindslaver in the main multiverse . When sacrificed, it gives a player outside the game control over a target player's turn, with neither the casting player nor the targeted player able to give advice.
The following artifacts are only mentioned in flavor text or appear as minor artifacts in the storyline .
